purpose: Make Q4 able to fail: an input the bank does NOT contain must score below an input it does.
measured_problem: POST-projection max-similarity is ~0.99 for EVERY input (synonym 0.9896 vs random baseline 0.0167 was a pre/post confusion). Nothing can be rejected.

design.S_membership: s(q) = max_k |<psi_q, psi_k>|, computed PRE-projection on the ingress wave only
design.S_margin: m(q) = beta*(top1 - top2) of the same similarities, beta=26.10 (shape, not level)
design.confound_to_be_shown: POST-projection max-similarity after the swarm, expected ~0.99 for all inputs
design.rationale: The swarm projection is the confound. The ingress wave still carries membership information.

families.F0_exact_inbank: corpus items verbatim (POSITIVE CONTROL, in bank)
families.F1_drop_last: corpus item minus its final word (HARD, out of bank, high overlap)
families.F2_drop_first: corpus item minus its first word (HARD, out of bank, high overlap)
families.F3_middle_chunk: middle three words only (MEDIUM, low overlap)
families.F4_synonym: zero-token-overlap paraphrases (hard by meaning, easy lexically)
families.F5_random_waves: 100 random unit waves (EASY FLOOR, sanity only)
families.F6_shuffled_order: corpus item, word order permuted, same token multiset

calibration: Threshold from F0 vs F5 ONLY. The eval families F1-F4 and F6 never set the threshold.

kill_conditions.K1: AUC(F0 vs F5) <= 0.60 -> statistic FALSIFIED (must approach 1.0)
kill_conditions.K2: shuffled-label control AUC outside [0.35,0.65] -> harness defect
kill_conditions.K3: F0 positive control min score < 0.999 -> gate mis-specified
kill_conditions.K4: if POST-projection similarity is not >=0.95 for >=90% of inputs, the confound claim is FALSIFIED

controls_that_can_fail: shuffled-label: randomize which query pairs with which bank row; AUC must collapse to ~0.5
accept-all threshold theta=0.0 must accept the random floor (false accept) - proves theta has meaning
honest_scope: dim=4096, CPU, small config, corpus N=10. This is an ENCODER-MEMBERSHIP test, NOT semantic understanding. No external benchmark is claimed.
